11th Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Fanning The Flame

Your reliance on your own skill, technique and combat prowess, puts you above other Uchiha on the same level as you. Their reliance on their Sharingan’s are a liability you don’t share.

While you are in a combat stance, granted by your Clan, you gain a rank of Mastery to your AC, and your Dexterity saving throws.

Additionally, You gain 2 additional special attacks, each associated with stances gained from the Divergent Techniques mutation.

Flame Bloom. While in Flaming Spark stance, select a point you can see within 60 feet of you, as you release a brilliant bloom of crimson flame, filling a 20-foot radius sphere centered on this point, forcing all creatures in the affected area to make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6+6 fire damage, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn, and 1 rank of Burned on a failed save, or half damage on a successful one.

Uchiha Swipe. While in Fanned Wind stance, you slam your fan down, creating a focused blast of force. All creatures in a 5-foot wide, 60-foot-long line, are forced to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, your choice, vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take three times your weapons damage, are pushed back 40-feet, and fall prone on a failed save or half as much damage and only pushed 5 feet on a successful one.
